provenance: Measured against client build 38797 from Rurik's own captures. Every entry here CONTRADICTS the imported OpenTyria tables in messages.json. import_msgdefs.py already says why that is expected: the imported catalog is marked 'authority: imported' and the client's own deserializer is the arbiter. This file is where the arbiter's verdicts go, so that regenerating messages.json from upstream does not silently undo them.

144.why: INSTANCE_LOAD_REQUEST_PLAYERS is 19 bytes on this build, not the imported 18. Decoding it as 18 left one byte in the stream and every following message was misframed: the decoder read 0x1201 (out of range) and abandoned the rest of the frame, so everything the client said after REQUEST_PLAYERS was invisible. Shifting one byte yields header 0x8092 followed by count 112, which is exactly the declared array8 cap of GAME_CMSG_0146 -- two independent agreements, not a lucky reading.
